title: Item counters
description: .arima/items/<id>.json: the counters the engine holds for a story, bug, incident or change request (03-contracts 9a). Written only by the state machine; an agent never writes it.

attempt.description: Review and QA rework attempts; starts at 1; mirrors Notion Attempt

run_failures.description: Failed runs of the current stage; reset when the stage changes

blocked_from.description: The status the item had before it was Blocked
